name: Nesa
rootCause: An attacker bridged 257.7 million NES, roughly $50 million, from Nesa to Ethereum in an incident consistent with the Cosmos EVM bug chain that hit MANTRA, TAC, and KiiChain. Nesa never published the mechanism; Bubblemaps estimated slippage cut net profit to roughly $60k.

descriptions.text: An attacker bridged 257.7 million NES, roughly $50 million, from Nesa to Ethereum in an incident consistent with the Cosmos EVM bug chain that hit MANTRA, TAC, and KiiChain. Nesa never published the mechanism; Bubblemaps estimated slippage cut net profit to roughly $60k.

Nesa Chain disclosed malicious activity on 2026-08-24 tied to a vulnerability in the shared Cosmos EVM module used by several Cosmos SDK networks. Public reporting stated that an attacker inflated NES balances on Nesa, bridged manipulated tokens to Ethereum, and attempted to liquidate them through decentralized exchanges, although realized proceeds were reportedly far smaller than the nominal inflated value. Public reporting consistently attributed the incident to a balance-accounting vulnerability in the shared Cosmos EVM module used by Nesa and other Cosmos SDK chains.
